758:t_1:578.en:
$$勝平$$
「Heh! Anyone dumb enough to get hit has only themselves to blame!」

758:t_1:579.en:
$$アキ$$
「Honestly, $$勝平$$! You haven't changed one bit!」

758:t_1:580.en:
$$ミチ$$
「Oh, let him be. Peace has finally come back, after all.」

758:t_1:581.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「...Geez. We finally meet again after all this time, and it's this...」

758:t_1:582.en:
$$梅江$$
「I'm sorry, you two. You came all the way from Nagano and Tokyo for us.」

758:t_1:583.en:
$$恵子$$
「It's all right, Grandma. There's still time before the signing ceremony.」

758:t_1:584.en:
$$一太郎$$
「Entrusting $$ザンボット$$ and $$ビアル星$$ to the military... Is this really all right, Grandpa?」

758:t_1:585.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「The fighting is over now, after all. And even though we're entrusting them, it's only temporary.」

758:t_1:587.en:
$$恵子$$
「Are we going to ride $$ザンボット$$ again?」

758:t_1:588.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「That's for you yourselves to decide. Surely $$ザンボット$$ has uses besides fighting.」

758:t_1:589.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「When you've learned all sorts of things and become able to decide matters properly, use $$ザンボット$$ of your own free will.」

758:t_1:590.en:
$$勝平$$
「In that case, I want to do jobs with $$ザンボット$$ like $$ワッ太$$!」

758:t_1:591.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'll call it the hyperdimensional world's do-anything business, $$神$$ Great Company!」

758:t_1:592.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Don't decide on your own. $$ザンボット$$ belongs to the three of us.」

758:t_1:593.en:
$$勝平$$
「What!? Are you and $$恵子$$ against it!?」

758:t_1:594.en:
$$恵子$$
「I'm not giving an answer yet. ...But your proposal isn't bad, $$勝平$$.」

758:t_1:596.en:
$$勝平$$
「Once the company's up, I'll be President, Big Bro Ichi will be Executive Director, and I'll make $$宇宙太$$ and $$恵子$$ department heads!」

758:t_1:598.en:
$$花江$$
「If you want to be someone who leads others, you'll have to work harder at your studies too.」

758:t_1:599.en:
$$勝平$$
「I can get by somehow without doing that stuff!」

758:t_1:600.en:
$$源五郎$$
「That won't do, $$勝平$$. No one will follow a man who runs away from the difficulties in front of him.」

758:t_1:601.en:
$$源五郎$$
「Look at $$ワッ太$$. Whatever he said, in the end he finished all of his homework.」

758:t_1:603.en:
$$源五郎$$
「Pay attention in class and take it seriously. This coming summer, homework will be the least of your worries.」

758:t_1:605.en:
$$源五郎$$
「That's right. I'm taking you out fishing with me.」

758:t_1:606.en:
$$勝平$$
「Yes! I'm finally a man of the sea!」

758:t_1:607.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「Learn, $$勝平$$... and you too, $$宇宙太$$ and $$恵子$$. For the sake of your bright futures.」

758:t_1:608.en:
$$勝平$$
(All right... I'll go out to sea and become an even stronger man.)

758:t_1:609.en:
$$勝平$$
(And someday, together with $$ザンボット$$, I'll become a man who roams the sea of space, and go see $$ワッ太$$ and everyone...!)

758:t_1:613.en:
$$ギャリソン$$
「...$$万丈$$, your client has arrived.」

758:t_1:614.en:
$$万丈$$
「Understood. Welcome them politely and show them in here.」

758:t_1:616.en:
$$トッポ$$
「The first customer's finally here, Big Bro $$万丈$$.」

758:t_1:617.en:
$$レイカ$$
「It's the $$破嵐$$ Detective Agency's first job, isn't it.」

758:t_1:619.en:
$$万丈$$
「I decided not to ask beforehand. It's not as if I'm in a position to pick and choose my jobs.」

758:t_1:620.en:
$$万丈$$
「But I'm certain of this much. Our client is a real beauty.」

758:t_1:622.en:
$$万丈$$
「I'm confident I was born under that kind of star.」

758:t_1:624.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「That's right. Especially with an assistant like me around.」

758:t_1:625.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Oh, $$ビューティ$$. Isn't that my line to say?」

758:t_1:626.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「What are you talking about! It's obviously my line!」

758:t_1:628.en:
$$万丈$$
「That's enough, you two. $$ギャリソン$$ is about to show the client in.」

758:t_1:630.en:
$$万丈$$
「From here begins my new battle.」

758:t_1:631.en:
$$万丈$$
(And the Sun is with me. Together with this world, forever...)

758:t_1:632.en:
$$万丈$$
(Thank you, $c... I'll never forget the days I fought alongside everyone.)

758:t_1:636.en:
$$メール$$
「...Which way are we going, Darling?」

758:t_1:637.en:
$$ランド$$
「East or west... Wherever the wind blows, wherever the fancy takes us...」

758:t_1:638.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's the wandering repairmen, $$ビーター・サービス$$.」

758:t_1:640.en:
$$メール$$
「That's what I'd like to say, but business is rough for us too, so we have to go wherever there's work!」

758:t_1:641.en:
$$ランド$$
「We finally got a brand-new world, and it's still this stingy...」

758:t_1:642.en:
???
「Still talking about hard times, I see.」

758:t_1:644.en:
$$シエロ$$
「Well, no need to worry. The recovery boom from the $$時空修復|lc$$ is here. $$ビーター・サービス$$ should hop on it too.」

758:t_1:647.en:
$$シエロ$$
「Looks like I worried you, $$メール$$. ...If I'd known it'd come to this, maybe I should've contacted you first...」

758:t_1:648.en:
$$ランド$$
「Contact...? Boss, you knew where we were?」

758:t_1:649.en:
$$シエロ$$
「Sure did. I heard all about you two from Dr. Fox.」

758:t_1:650.en:
$$メール$$
「Fox...? You mean Dr. $$トライア$$!?」

758:t_1:651.en:
$$ランド$$
「How do you and Sis $$トライア$$ even know each other!?」

758:t_1:652.en:
$$シエロ$$
「How, you ask... I was the chief mechanic of the $$ソーラリアン$$, you know.」

758:t_1:654.en:
$$シエロ$$
「After it was finished, I serviced $$ＺＯＮＥ$$, and in the end I was chief engineer of the $$スヴェル$$.」

758:t_1:655.en:
$$シエロ$$
「So I was supporting Earth and you two from behind the scenes, too.」

758:t_1:657.en:
$$ランド$$
「No matter how busy you were, you could've at least dropped by for a minute!」

758:t_1:658.en:
$$シエロ$$
「Don't be ridiculous! How's a retired old boss supposed to keep popping in on a $$ビーター・サービス$$ that's passed to a new generation!」

758:t_1:659.en:
$$シエロ$$
「Besides, I'm not so thick as to barge in on a newlywed household.」

758:t_1:661.en:
$$ランド$$
「Like daughter, like father... You haven't changed a bit, Boss...」

758:t_1:662.en:
$$メール$$
「But I'm glad. That Dad approved of my marriage to Darling.」

758:t_1:663.en:
$$シエロ$$
「It just snowballed, that's all. Once you're handed a done deal, a father's helpless.」
